title: Go HTTP GET with retry and backoff
context: Retries idempotent GET requests with exponential backoff: waits of 100ms, 200ms, 400ms and so on, capped at 5s, for at most maxAttempts attempts in total. Network errors and 5xx responses are retried; any other response is returned immediately with its body open. Every response that is not returned must have its body closed. Waiting stops when ctx is cancelled.
code: func GetWithRetry(ctx context.Context, c *http.Client, url string, maxAttempts int) (*http.Response, error) {
req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, url, nil)

expected.why: off by one: attempt 0 waits 200ms instead of 100ms; the shift must be 1<<attempt
the 5xx response body is never closed before retrying, leaking the connection
backoff already returns a Duration; multiplying by time.Millisecond turns 100ms into about 28 hours
